cards.name: Dauntless Dismantler
cards.oracle_text:
Artifacts your opponents control enter the battlefield tapped.
{X}{X}{W}, Sacrifice Dauntless Dismantler: Destroy each artifact with mana value X.
cards.flavor_text: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

cards.name: Fleeting Riches
cards.oracle_text:
Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
You may sacrifice a Treasure. If you do, this spell deals 2 damage to any target.
cards.flavor_text: "In the chaos of battle, even a moment of distraction can turn into a spark that ignites treasure."

cards.name: In Bolas's Clutches
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant permanent
You control enchanted permanent.
Enchanted permanent is legendary.
cards.flavor_text:
"Your contract is in default. You belong to me now. Serve, or die."
—Nicol Bolas

cards.name: Ravaging Duelist
cards.oracle_text: Whenever Ravaging Duelist attacks, it deals 1 damage to target creature defending player controls.
cards.flavor_text: Victory belongs to those who dare to challenge fate.

cards.name: Scholar's Insight
cards.oracle_text:
You draw a card.
Learn. (You may reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.)
cards.flavor_text: "Knowledge is as much about failure as it is about success. Embrace both."

cards.name: Reject
cards.oracle_text: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell unless its controller pays {3}. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
cards.flavor_text:
"Grux, for the last time, you have to do more than simply shout 'Apply!' at the administrators."
—Pavil, admissions officer

cards.name: Boulder Dash
cards.oracle_text: Boulder Dash deals 2 damage to any target and 1 damage to any other target.
cards.flavor_text: It was the first year the downhill event had been included in the Frogtosser Games. It would also be the last.

cards.name: Fleetfoot Dancer
cards.flavor_text: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge. When word spread of how many were slain at the first event, it became a citywide obsession.

cards.name: Cavern's Insight
cards.oracle_text:

• Target creature you control explores.
cards.flavor_text:
"The echoes of ancient wisdom can guide our path through the dark."
—Keira, Merfolk scholar
